n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Mum says I can't go to Jake's tonight unless I tidy my room. It's impossible. Look at it!

translations.fa: مامان می‌گه امشب نمی‌تونم برم خونهٔ جیک مگر اینکه اتاقم را مرتب کنم. غیرممکنه. نگاش کن!

branches.suggestion: Wow. It looks like a bomb hit it!
It's not impossible. I'll help you.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Would you? Legend. If you help me, I'll teach you how to play FIFA properly.

translations.fa: واقعاً؟ اسطوره‌ای. اگه کمکم کنی، یادت می‌دم چطوری درست FIFA بازی کنی.

branches.suggestion: Deal. But you're doing the dirty socks!
branches.suggestionFa: قبول. ولی جوراب‌های کثیف با خودت!

branches.suggestion: How about if you also make me a cup of tea?
branches.suggestionFa: چطوره یه چای هم برام درست کنی؟

cultureNote.en: "Legend!" is informal British slang to thank someone who is being very helpful.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Fine, fine. Where do we start? There are clothes everywhere.

translations.fa: باشه، باشه. از کجا شروع کنیم؟ همه‌جا لباسه.

branches.suggestion: First, let's put the dirty clothes in the wash basket.
branches.suggestionFa: اول، بیا لباس‌های کثیف را بذاریم تو سبد رخت‌چرک.

branches.suggestion: Let's start with the floor. I can't see it!
branches.suggestionFa: از کف شروع کنیم. نمی‌تونم ببینمش!

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: OK. Oh — I found my headphones! I've been looking for these for a month.

translations.fa: باشه. آه — هدفونم را پیدا کردم! یه ماهه دنبالشون می‌گردم.

branches.suggestion: What's that smell? Is that a sandwich?

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Uh… it might be from last week. Don't tell Mum! If you keep it secret, I'll do the washing up tomorrow.

translations.fa: اوه… شاید مال هفتهٔ پیش باشه. به مامان نگو! اگه مخفی نگهش داری، فردا ظرف‌ها را می‌شورم.

branches.suggestion: Fine. But you're washing up for a week.
branches.suggestionFa: باشه. ولی یه هفته ظرف می‌شوری.

branches.suggestion: Ha! Your secret is safe with me.

cultureNote.en: British vs American: do the washing up (UK) = do the dishes (US).

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: A week? You drive a hard bargain. Fine. Mum! Come and look — it's spotless!

translations.fa: یه هفته؟ سخت چونه می‌زنی. باشه. مامان! بیا ببین — برق می‌زنه!
